search_log: Listed every Amgen filing (CIK 0000318154, all forms) via data.sec.gov/submissions; 'Aimovig — U.S.' rows read from each 10-Q/10-K (quarter's own document) and from Exhibit 99.1 for Q4 where the release prints an Aimovig line (2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2023); Q4 2022, 2024 and 2025 derived as 10-K full year less nine months (scripts/amgn.py).
Amgen's Q2 2018 release and 10-Q print no Aimovig line (launched May 2018); the 2Q18 value of 2 is the prior-year column of the 2Q19 10-Q (direct_prior_year_column).

From 2021Q3 Amgen also prints 'Aimovig — ROW' (2 to 7 per quarter) and the releases a Total column, but the 10-Q/10-K print no Total Aimovig row and releases of 2022 and 2024-2026 print no Aimovig row, so a worldwide series is not citable without summing U.S. and ROW ourselves; the U.S. line (consistent definition for all quarters) is the series.
